notes.title: Lust Theory 2 TRANSLATIONS UPDATE
notes.content:
It's finally here the long-awaited translation update for [b]Lust Theory 2[/b] we hope you will like this update. 
If you find any bugs feel free to report them on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aD8dcdqmMt]Discord channel[/url]

Update 2.1.0 notes:

[list]
[*] 10 New Languages: German, Greek, Indonesian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian,

[*] 50+ New In-Game Songs: Fresh tracks to enhance your experience.

[*] Enhanced Animations with SFX: Improved sound effects to make animations even more immersive.

[*] 100+ New Sounds: We've added over 100 new audio elements to elevate the overall gameplay atmosphere!

[*] Fixed widely reported "Change Relationship" bug
[/list]

Best regards,
Inceton games team

notes.title: Lust Theory Season 2 - Beach Day FREE DLC UPDATE
notes.content:
Summer's officially over, let's end it with a BANG! This update is hot AF if I may say so. Time for a fun day at the beach with ALL the main girls (Yes, there's quite a lot of steamy scenes) thanks to some omnipotent assistance. We hope you'll enjoy the many different and fun interactions we got in store for you. 

We're also testing out a new feature and would love your feedback on it. Finally, we implemented "ambience" sounds to further enhance your immersion.

Lust Theory S2 - Beach Day features:
910+ NEW IMAGES
24+ NEW ANIMATIONS
Narrator voice (This is a test only working in this Beach Day event)
New "Ambience" sounds

[b]You can start the "Beach Day" event after completing the main story while choosing to stay in the simulation and then cliking on the floating sphere in the living room.[/b]

Best regards,
Inceton Games Team
